back2basics.text: The creamy layer concept excludes economically advanced individuals within the Other Backward Classes (OBC) from reservation benefits to ensure affirmative action reaches the genuinely disadvantaged. The policy uses income and wealth criteria to identify the non-creamy layer eligible for reservations in education and government jobs. Judicial interpretations clarify how these criteria are applied and whether decisions affect past recruitments or only future cases.

2026-11-06-pm-470e7489bd.deck: The Supreme Court clarified on November 6, 2026, that its March 11 judgment on the OBC creamy layer policy does not require revising past service allocations or seniority. back2basics.concept: Air Quality Index (AQI) and Pollution Levels
back2basics.text: The Air Quality Index (AQI) is a numerical scale used to communicate how polluted the air currently is or how polluted it is forecast to become. It ranges from 'good' to 'severe' levels, with higher values indicating worse air quality. 'Severe' pollution means the air is harmful even to healthy individuals and poses serious health risks to vulnerable groups. Factors like weather conditions, emissions from vehicles, industries, and seasonal activities like crop burning affect AQI.

2026-11-06-pm-9e73e33444.deck: Delhi's air quality worsened to a 'severe' level on November 6, 2026, affecting many parts of the city and nearby regions. This is important for UPSC aspirants to understand urban pollution dynamics, health impacts, and government monitoring systems.

back2basics.text: Monetary policy tools are instruments used by central banks like RBI to regulate money supply and interest rates in the economy. back2basics.text: Investment promotion policies are state or central government initiatives designed to attract and facilitate industrial and economic investments. They often include incentives such as subsidies, tax benefits, and streamlined approval processes to encourage businesses to invest in specific sectors or regions. These policies aim to boost employment, industrial growth, and economic development by creating a favorable environment for investors.

body.label: Job-linked incentives
body.text: The policy offers employer EPF contribution reimbursements with 100% reimbursement for women and transgender employees in MSMEs for 10 years, and 75% for women in eligible service units.

body.label: Assistance on fixed capital investment
body.text: Assistance ranges from 100% for regular units, 110% for thrust sector units in priority areas, and 120% for thrust-sector units located in priority areas, capped at 10 years or until the ceiling is reached.

body.text: Sectors such as semiconductors, electronics, green hydrogen, waste-to-energy, emerging digital technologies, EVs and batteries, defence, and food and marine processing are prioritized.

body.label: Project approval timelines
body.text: The policy promises a 30-day delivery of certificates of intent, 45-day timeline for certificates of eligibility, and dedicated relationship officers for large projects.

body.label: Additional support measures
body.text: Waiver of surcharges on renewable energy open access until March 2030 and special assistance for sick and closed industrial units that can be revived.

body.label: Focus on industrial revival
body.text: The policy aims to end extortion and create a positive industrial atmosphere, with the government handing over land to 33 business groups and preparing a GIS-mapped land inventory.
